mapper.select: SELECT /* org.bplte.core.api.domain.schedule.mapper.ScheduleMapper.selectSchedule */ A.SCHEDULE_NUMBER AS scheduleNumber , B.CATEGORY_NUMBER AS categoryNumber , B.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , B.COLOR AS cateogryColor , A.TITLE AS title , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , A.DEL_YN AS delYn , DATE_FORMAT(A.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt , A.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId , C.USER_NAME AS rgtrName , CONCAT(C.USER_NAME, '(', A.RGTR_ID, ')') AS rgtrInfo , DATE_FORMAT(A.MDFCN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS mdfcnDt , A.MDFR_ID AS mdfrId , D.USER_NAME AS mdfrName , CONCAT(D.USER_NAME, '(', A.MDFR_ID, ')') AS mdfrInfo FROM TBL_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBL_SCHEDULE_CATEGORY B ON B.CATEGORY_NUMBER = A.CATEGORY_NUMBER INNER JOIN TBL_USER C ON C.USER_ID = A.RGTR_ID INNER JOIN TBL_USER D ON D.USER_ID = A.MDFR_ID WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.RGTR_ID = #{currentUserId} AND A.SCHEDULE_NUMBER = #{scheduleNumber}
